title: Gotrade Daily: Chip Rally Meets a Caution Signal
summary: AMD and Intel led a chip rally on Wall Street, but spiking pessimism and a quad-witching Friday test tonight US session. See the watchlist and catalysts.
body_markdown:
### Semiconductor rally


Chips were the stars. **AMD ([AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) )** and **Intel ([INTC](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/intc/) )** led, with the positive tone spilling over to names like **Broadcom ([AVGO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/avgo/) )** and **Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** . The question is whether the momentum holds on an expiry day.


### Big pharma trial results


Pharma was busy with trial news. **Novo Nordisk ([NVO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvo/) )** halted two more heart-drug trials, **Novartis ([NVS](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvs/) )** logged its third setback in a week, while **AstraZeneca ([AZN](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/azn/) )** delivered a positive lung-drug readout. It underscores that trial outcomes can move pharma names both ways, and none of this is a recommendation to buy or sell.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


US futures direction will get clearer near the open. Beyond the chip names, watch the follow-through in pharma and in volatile AI names like CoreWeave. Pre-market percentages are filled closer to publish.


## Macro Note 📝


Crude oil posted back-to-back losses as the Saudi supply outlook improved, a mild risk-on tailwind. The biggest factor tonight remains quad-witching, which can add volume and pinning into the close.


## Conclusion


Tonight sets up a tug of war: strong AI and chip momentum against a caution signal from spiking pessimism and an expiry day. For anyone watching, it is about balancing opportunity with risk discipline.
